# Upscale

> Increase image resolution: crisp upscale keeps the content and costs $0.004 per request, creative upscale also regenerates fine detail and faces.

Upscale increases the resolution of a raster image. Crisp upscale makes the image sharper and cleaner and keeps the content the same. Creative upscale regenerates fine detail and faces.

<CardGroup cols={3}>
  <Card title="From $0.004" icon="https://mintcdn.com/recraft/dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO/icons/credits-fill.svg?fit=max&auto=format&n=dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO&q=85&s=411698b1ce815a1634dd83c0b7332cff" width="16" height="16" data-path="icons/credits-fill.svg">per request, \$0.25 for creative upscale</Card>
  <Card title="PNG, JPG, WEBP" icon="https://mintcdn.com/recraft/dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO/icons/upscale.svg?fit=max&auto=format&n=dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO&q=85&s=bd9eb97686f01416abd88d166630cb1f" width="16" height="16" data-path="icons/upscale.svg">up to 20 MB, 16 MP</Card>
  <Card title="POST /v1/images/crispUpscale" icon="https://mintcdn.com/recraft/dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO/icons/api.svg?fit=max&auto=format&n=dlnQgLElJIYDw2GO&q=85&s=eace772046907259477c5fa36adeb139" width="16" height="16" data-path="icons/api.svg">and /v1/images/creativeUpscale</Card>
</CardGroup>

## Try it

Get an API token on your [profile page](https://app.recraft.ai/profile/api) (it needs a positive API units balance) and set it once per terminal session:

```bash theme={null}
export RECRAFT_API_TOKEN=your_token
```

Then run. The request upscales a public sample illustration with crisp upscale:

<CodeGroup>
  ```bash cURL theme={null}
  curl https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $RECRAFT_API_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "image_url": "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png"
    }'
  ```

  ```python Python theme={null}
  # pip install requests
  import os

  import requests

  response = requests.post(
      'https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale',
      headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RECRAFT_API_TOKEN']}"},
      json={
          'image_url': 'https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png',
      },
  )
  if not response.ok:
      raise SystemExit(f'{response.status_code}: {response.text}')
  print(response.json()['image']['url'])
  ```

  ```javascript JavaScript theme={null}
  // Node.js 18+, run as an ES module (file.mjs)
  const response = await fetch('https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RECRAFT_API_TOKEN}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      image_url: 'https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png',
    }),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await response.text());
  const result = await response.json();
  console.log(result.image.url);
  ```

  ```python Python (OpenAI SDK) theme={null}
  # pip install openai
  import os

  from openai import OpenAI

  client = OpenAI(
      base_url='https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1',
      api_key=os.environ['RECRAFT_API_TOKEN'],
  )

  response = client.post(
      path='/images/crispUpscale',
      cast_to=object,
      body={
          'image_url': 'https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png',
      },
  )
  print(response['image']['url'])
  ```
</CodeGroup>

## Response

```json theme={null}
{
  "created": 1759140000,
  "credits": 4,
  "image": {
    "image_id": "0e6a1b8c-5b1f-4a8e-9f3a-2c7d4e8b9a10",
    "url": "https://..."
  }
}
```

* The result is a single `image`, not a `data` array. `image.url` points to a raster file in the `image_format` you choose.
* Image URLs are temporary: files are kept for about 24 hours, so download them. See [Limits and sizes](/docs/api-reference/appendix#image-storage).
* `credits` is the number of API units charged for the request: 4 for crisp upscale, 250 for creative upscale.

## Parameters

Both endpoints take the same parameters. Only the input limits differ.

### Crisp upscale

`POST /v1/images/crispUpscale` costs \$0.004 per request.

| Parameter | Type, default | Description |
| - | - | - |
| `image_url` | string, **required** in JSON | URL or data URL of the input image. |
| `file` | file, **required** in multipart | The input image, uploaded instead of `image_url`. |
| `response_format` | string, `url` | `url`, `b64_json`, or `multipart`. See [Image inputs and results](/docs/api-reference/image-inputs-and-results#image-results). |
| `image_format` | string, `webp` | `webp` (lossless) or `png`. See [Image format](/docs/api-reference/image-inputs-and-results#image-format). |

The input image must be PNG, JPG, or WEBP, under 20 MB, up to 16 MP, with sides between 32 and 4096 px. See [Input images](/docs/api-reference/appendix#input-images).

### Creative upscale

`POST /v1/images/creativeUpscale` costs \$0.25 per request.

| Parameter | Type, default | Description |
| - | - | - |
| `image_url` | string, **required** in JSON | URL or data URL of the input image. |
| `file` | file, **required** in multipart | The input image, uploaded instead of `image_url`. |
| `response_format` | string, `url` | `url`, `b64_json`, or `multipart`. See [Image inputs and results](/docs/api-reference/image-inputs-and-results#image-results). |
| `image_format` | string, `webp` | `webp` (lossless) or `png`. See [Image format](/docs/api-reference/image-inputs-and-results#image-format). |

The input image must be PNG, JPG, or WEBP, under 20 MB, up to 16 MP, with sides between 256 and 4096 px. See [Input images](/docs/api-reference/appendix#input-images).

## Examples

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Upload a local file">
    <CodeGroup>
      ```bash cURL theme={null}
      curl https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $RECRAFT_API_TOKEN" \
        -F "file=@image.png"
      ```

      ```python Python theme={null}
      import os

      import requests

      with open('image.png', 'rb') as image:
          response = requests.post(
              'https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale',
              headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RECRAFT_API_TOKEN']}"},
              files={'file': image},
          )
      if not response.ok:
          raise SystemExit(f'{response.status_code}: {response.text}')
      print(response.json()['image']['url'])
      ```
    </CodeGroup>
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Creative upscale">
    Creative upscale regenerates fine detail and faces. Send the same request to `creativeUpscale`.

    <CodeGroup>
      ```bash cURL theme={null}
      curl https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/creativeUpscale \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $RECRAFT_API_TOKEN" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{
          "image_url": "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png"
        }'
      ```

      ```python Python theme={null}
      import os

      import requests

      response = requests.post(
          'https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/creativeUpscale',
          headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RECRAFT_API_TOKEN']}"},
          json={
              'image_url': 'https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png',
          },
      )
      if not response.ok:
          raise SystemExit(f'{response.status_code}: {response.text}')
      print(response.json()['image']['url'])
      ```
    </CodeGroup>
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Get the file in the response">
    `b64_json` returns the image bytes inside the JSON response, so there is no URL to download. Set `image_format` to `png` to get a PNG.

    ```python theme={null}
    import base64
    import os

    import requests

    response = requests.post(
        'https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/crispUpscale',
        headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RECRAFT_API_TOKEN']}"},
        json={
            'image_url': 'https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/655727fe69827d9a402de12c/679b82f54ef9617939df9d8e_motorcycle--going-fast.png',
            'response_format': 'b64_json',
            'image_format': 'png',
        },
    )
    if not response.ok:
        raise SystemExit(f'{response.status_code}: {response.text}')
    with open('upscaled.png', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(response.json()['image']['b64_json']))
    ```
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
